messages:
Nina R: Heads-up — new users hitting onboarding hang in sampleapp when using the JS SDK (v1.10.0). Direct REST POST works fine.
Nina R: Quick repro: run sampleapp, click Import creds -> modal shows 'verifying' and never finishes. Devtools show repeated 401 responses.
Caleb W: can you dump the outgoing request headers from the SDK?
Nina R: SDK request (from network tab):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx
User-Agent: Redwood-SDK/1.10.0
// note: no X-Redwood-Client header
```
Curl that succeeds (server behaves differently):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx"
  -H "X-Redwood-Client: sampleapp/0.9"
  -d '{"model":"fast-7b","prompt":"yo"}'
```
Priya D: couple issues here: 1) SDK appears to be dropping unknown headers (so X-Redwood-Client isn't forwarded) which can change routing on the server; 2) retry middleware is retrying on 401 which keeps spinner alive; that should be disabled for auth failures.
Caleb W: also spotted param name drift: some admin HTTP endpoints use `model_id`, some callers send `model` or `modelName`. SDK surface only accepts `model` which leads to 400s or double-encoding in some flows.
Nina R: toss in that REST supports `idempotency_key` for model create but SDK doesn't expose it — leads to duplicate creates when users click quickly.
ops-bot: Ticket T-7829 created (devex/sdk): "SDK parity: header passthrough, retry-on-401, model param normalization"
Priya D: proposed plan: a) stop retrying on 4xx except 429, b) preserve unknown headers end-to-end, c) add admin.listModels + adapters to accept model/model_id/modelName and normalize to model_id, d) expose optional idempotency_key on relevant SDK calls.
Caleb W: I'll draft the SDK changes & tests. Nina, can you add a tiny e2e smoke test in sampleapp that simulates an invalid key and asserts we surface 401 immediately (no retries) and that outgoing requests include X-Redwood-Client?
Nina R: yes, will add smoke test and attach HAR to the ticket. ETA: PR by EOD, test added in same branch.
